text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The stands roared over the heavyweight 
slugfest! As expected, Hishi Akebono's 
races were acclaimed as truly special and 
uplifting.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle and Hishi Akebono were also 
thoroughly satisfied with their 
heart-thumping, all-out showdown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We vow to definitely race each other 
again!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, next up is the Sprinters Stakes. 
The days of rigorous training for the 
rematch begin—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Hishi Akebono looked down at her 
legs, as if noticing something.
